svg.aria-label: DelayedBuy. A browser simulation of a 24-hour reservation for one fictional lamp: a shopper requests the displayed price, a simulated merchant accepts and holds the unit, and a return, cancellation or expiry releases it. No purchase is created. Shown as a lamp under a glass dome while 24 hour marks light around it, then the dome lifts.
